409 ( CDIX ) was a common year starting on Friday of the Julian calendar .

It was the 409th year of the Common Era ( CE ) and Anno Domini ( AD ) designations , the 409th year of the 1st millennium , the 9th year of the 5th century , and the 10th and last year of the 400s decade .
Various animal species exhibit " same - sex sexual behavior " ( SSSB ) , including sexual activity , courtship , pair bonding , and parenting .
Found across numerous vertebrate and arthropod classes , SSSB is most commonly observed in social species .
Scientists have documented these behaviors in over 1,500 species .

While same - sex interactions occur widely , exclusive homosexual orientation is rare outside of humans , with the domestic sheep ( Ovis aries ) being the only other species known to exhibit it routinely , involving about 10 % of rams .
Bruce Bagemihl argues that scientific hypotheses regarding these behaviors are often shaped by human interpretation .
Proposed causes for SSSB include mistaken identity , social bonding , dominance expression , and practice for reproductive behavior .
Genetic , hormonal , and neurological factors have also been identified as potential bases for these behavioral differences .
In relation to humans
Applying the term homosexual to animals
The term homosexual was originally coined in 1868 to describe human attraction .
It s application to animals is debated because animal motivations are poorly understood and the term carries heavy human cultural weight .
However , many researchers prefer it over terms like " gay " or " lesbian , " which are even more anthropomorphic .
Terminology often distinguishes between temporary sexual acts and long - term pair bonds .

Scientific literature generally applies " homosexuality " to any sexual interaction between animals of the same sex , though most such animals are functionally bisexual within their overall behavioral repertoire .
Nature Animal SSSB has been used in social and legal arguments regarding human sexuality , specifically challenging the idea that it is a " sin against nature . "
These observations were notably cited by the American Psychological Association in the United States Supreme Court case Lawrence v. Texas , which overturned state sodomy laws .
Research A major challenge in research is the frequent lack of distinction between animals that are exclusively same - sex oriented and those that mate with both sexes .

Additionally , laboratory studies often elicit these behaviors through artificial means , such as brain tissue alteration or hormone exposure , which may not reflect spontaneous behavior in the wild .
Historical mentions of animal homosexuality date back to Aristotle , who described same - sex copulation in birds 2,300 years ago .
Large - scale academic research was delayed for centuries , likely due to observer bias and social stigma .
Biologist Janet Mann notes that researchers in this field often face higher scrutiny than their peers .
Some theories suggest SSSB originates from social dominance , while others propose it serves to strengthen alliances .
In non-monogamous species like sheep , 8 % of rams show a permanent preference for male partners even when females are available .
Recent studies suggest these behaviors may evolve to improve group stability by reducing internal conflict .
Basis Performative sexual behaviors require energy , and because SSSB does not produce offspring , it is often called a " Darwinian paradox . "
Several hypotheses attempt to explain how such traits emerge and persist .
Physiological basis
There is no single agreed - upon physiological cause for SSSB .
Some researchers point to varying sex hormones or gonad size as factors , though studies on gulls found no such differences between homosexual and heterosexual pairs .
Experimental treatments of testosterone and estradiol have been shown to increase same - sex behavior in some species .
Genetic and Neurobiological basis Genetic studies have successfully induced same - sex behavior in laboratory settings .
For example , disabling the fucose mutarotase gene in mice caused females to exhibit male - like sexual preferences .
Additionally , neurotransmitters like serotonin and dopamine have been shown to play roles in the sexual orientation and courtship behavior of rodents and fruit flies .
Other hypotheses Adaptive functions of SSSB include mutual social benefits .

In black swans , male - male pairs are highly successful at defending territory ; their offspring ( obtained via a female ) have an 80 % survival rate , significantly higher than the 30 % rate for traditional male - female pairs .
Evolutionary theories Research on birds suggests that homosexual behavior is influenced by the energy demands of parental care .
In species where one sex is largely responsible for raising young , such as in polygamous systems , the " released " sex frequently engages in same - sex behaviors .
In contrast , socially monogamous species that require high investment from both parents show lower frequencies of these behaviors due to the high energy costs of survival and chick - rearing .
A 2019 hypothesis proposes that sexual behavior was originally indiscriminate , occurring before the evolution of specific mate - recognition traits like color or odor .
This theory suggests that homosexual behavior persisted because it rarely posed a significant enough biological cost to be eliminated by natural selection .

While intense environmental pressures might lead to strictly heterosexual mating in some species , others benefit from reduced " mate recognition " costs by maintaining a more fluid range of sexual behaviors .

Since the version 2.3 ( Gingerbread ) of Google 's Android operating system an easter egg containing an animation has been hidden .
The easter egg can be accessed through the " Settings " application , in the " About phone " section , by repeatedly tapping the " Android version " section .
The animation is different in every version of the Operating System .
In 2.3 – 2.3.7 ( Gingerbread ) there is a painting of an Android next to a zombie gingerbread man , surrounded by zombies using cellphones .
In 3.0 – 3.2.6 ( Honeycomb ) there is a blue honeybee .
Below it , there is the text " REZZZZZZZ … " as a reference to Tron : Legacy .
In 4.0 – 4.0.4 ( Ice Cream Sandwich ) there is pixel art of an ice cream sandwich android .
Long - pressing it will result in many ice cream sandwich androids flying across the screen , dubbed the " nyan droid " as they are a tribute to Nyan Cat .
In 4.1 – 4.3.1 ( Jelly Bean ) a red jelly bean appears , which if pressed will show its face along with the OS version .
If this jelly bean is then long - pressed , an interactive jelly bean minigame will appear .
This is where one can fling the jelly beans around .
In 4.4 ( KitKat ) a rotating letter " K " appears , which if continually tapped turns into the text " Android " in the styling of a KitKat logo .
If the Android logo is then long - pressed a tile interface , known as " a daydream " called " Dessert Case " , loads with icons from all previous versions of Android .
It appears to be a mock of the Windows Phone interface .
In 5.x ( Lollipop ) and 6.x ( Marshmallow ) , a colored circle appears ( or a circle with a stylized M inside in Marshmallow ) .
If continuously tapped , it will turn into a lollipop with the text lollipop inside ( or the M changes into a marshmallow in 6.x ) .
Tapping the circle changes the color .
When long - pressed , a game of Flappy Bird starts with the Android mascot instead .
In Marshmallow , tapping the plus sign adds extra players ( up to five ) , which can be controlled by the user or other players .
For Android 5 , it will be a lollipop , and you ca n't change the player amount .
In 7.0 ( Nougat ) , an " N " appears , which will enable another Easter egg if tapped .

This Easter egg , titled " Android Neko " as a reference to the cat collecting mobile game Neko Atsume , can be accessed from the Quick Settings menu , and allows the user to create virtual treats , which will eventually attract kittens .
The kittens can be viewed in a gallery - style screen .
Additionally , long - pressing on the aforementioned " N " repeatedly will alternate between displaying the no symbol emoji and the cat face emoji , respectively toggling the Easter egg on and off .
" No " and " cat " is a mondegreen for " nougat " .
In 8.0 ( Oreo ) , instead of the normal way of going to the easter egg , heading to System >
About Phone and tapping on the Android version repeatedly will launch the easter egg .
An orange circle appears , representing an " O " for Oreo .
Tapping on it a few times will open a blue screen representing a sea with an octopus floating around .
The " O " in octopus represents Oreo while the eight legs on the octopus represent the version ( 8.0 ) .
The octopus can be moved by dragging the head around .
This goes with Android 8.1 Oreo , but instead of the orange O is an Oreo cookie with Bugdroid in it .
In 9.0 ( Pie ) , the Easter egg is found by going to System > About Phone >
Android version and then tapping three times on the Android version on the next screen .
A white , extended " P " will then appear , usually with concentric colored circles disappearing into the " P " .
Each time the Easter egg is invoked , it displays different colors .
The animation can be pinched to zoom .
Tap it for some time and you can draw .
In 10.0 ( 10 ) , the text " android 10 " will appear , where each of the texts " android " , " 1 " , and " 0 " can be moved and rotated .
Rotating " 1 " and merging with the digit " 0 " will result in the " android Q " text .
In this state , tapping the " Q " several times will reveal a Nonogram game , where the resulting pictures are various icons of Android .
In 11.0 ( Dots ) , a circle with 9 white dots around the circle and 1 other dot inside the circle the perimeter will appear .
Dragging your finger around the circle will change the inside dots position .
When the dot inside dot is at the last white dots space , there will be a text saying ' 11 ' .
Then a message with the emoji ' 🐱 ' will appear .
When dragging the inner dot back to the first white dot there will be a message saying '🚫 '
In 12 and 13 ( Clock ) , an interactive clock will appear .

Setting the clock time to 12:00 ( or 1:00 for Android 13 ) will change the clock to a circle with text inside that says ' 12 ' ( or , on Android 13 , ' 13 ' ) and many circles will appear in the background .
But in android 13 , if you tap and hold the number , the outer circles will change to an emoji .
In 14 , 15 , and 16 , the Android 14 ( , 15 or 16 ) logo appears .
Long pressing the logo will make the phone vibrate , then an interactive space open world game appears , with stars and planets set at realistic distances .
But for Android 16 , there will be an icon named " AUTO " , if you tap on it , the spaceship will navigate itself to the target planet .
And in all android 14 - 16 , you can pass through the Sun without any damage .
In android 17 ( Cinnamon bun ) , it is the same as the android 16's Easter eggs , except that you will draw a circle at the start , only then that you can play .
